scheme_name: Pre-matric Scholarship For SC Students - Uttarakhand
other_conditions: Must be studying in a recognized school/institution in Uttarakhand
Must have passed the previous year’s examination
Must not be studying in more than one school in the same academic year
Name on the scholarship application must match the name on Aadhaar and the bank account
Guardian’s mobile number must be provided
The mobile number can be shared by more than one student of the same family
benefits_summary: Students receive annual financial assistance ranging from Rs. 600 for classes 1‑5 up to Rs. 6,250 for hostel‑living students of classes 9‑10.
